learning_outcomes.text: Acquisition of mathematical knowledge necessary for engineers, such as: probability and mathematical statistics, holomorphic complex functions and Laplace transform, numerical methods for solving equations, polynomial approximation and interpolation.
Application of fundamental mathematical knowledge using the MatLab program in general and specialized engineering for solving problems specific to the field.

syllabus_topics: Elements of Probability Theory: Classical probabilistic models. Discrete and continuous random variables. Theoretical distribution laws
Function approximation. Interpolation polynomials, Least squares approximation
Elements of Mathematical Statistics: Data series. Statistical indicators. Linear regression
Numerical calculus: numerical solution of algebraic equations and systems, numerical solution of differential equations and systems, numerical integration
assessment_rules: 100% laboratory attendance is required. A minimum grade of 5 is required for the laboratory test. A minimum average grade of 5 is required for the seminar tests. A minimum grade of 5 is required for the exam.
bibliography: C. Lăzureanu, Probabilități – Teorie și aplicații (în format electronic).
